summary: Avro incremental SIEM delta feed with per-batch Ed25519-signed manifest, tenant retention map, and compliance attachments for EU bank
description: Customer (NordBank ASA) requests a production-ready incremental SIEM export delivered in Avro container format with the following non-standard requirements: per-batch Ed25519 detached signatures, a machine-readable tenant_retention_map describing per-field retention/TTL and legal-hold flags, timezone-normalized deltas (UTC canonical plus local-bank timezone mapping for reconciliation), and a compliance evidence package (sample GLUE schema, checksum manifest, and answers to regulator questionnaire). The feed will be consumed by the bank's Splunk/ELK bridge and must be demonstrably replayable and verifiable for audit. Impact: customer cannot onboard until signed-manifest and retention semantics are validated by their security and legal teams. Request is time-sensitive due to upcoming regulator audit window.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Customer-provided sink: SFTP endpoint and initial auth keys.
2) Customer requests hourly deltas partitioned by tenant and day, Avro container per hour.
3) Each Avro file must be accompanied by a small JSON manifest (manifest_v1) with fields: batch_id, start_ts, end_ts, record_count, sha256_checksum, and detached ed25519_signature.
4) Customer will validate signature and checksum and run reconciliation against their local timezone representation.
5) Support/SRE to provide sample payloads and signature verification script for bank to test.

comments: 2026-03-10 - NordBank (security@ nordbank.no): We need a signed manifest for every hourly Avro chunk; our SIEM bridge will reject unsigned batches.

2026-03-10 - Support (Ava Chen): Acknowledged. Opening triage ticket and validating that ed25519 signing is supported by our signing-service. We will provide sample files and a verification script. ETA for initial sample: 48 hours.

2026-03-11 - Eng (Ravi Patel): Preliminary triage: platform signing-service currently issues RSA-PSS signatures via KMS-backed keys. Native ed25519 support is not live in managed signing-service. Two paths: (A) emit RSA-PSS manifest today (accepted by some customers) and include verification script; (B) implement ed25519 signing flow (requires HSM/KMS support + deployment) — estimate 2-3 weeks. Asking customer whether RSA-PSS is acceptable as interim.

2026-03-11 - NordBank (security@ nordbank.no): RSA-PSS is acceptable only if legal/ops can verify non-repudiation and key provenance; they prefer ed25519 but can accept RSA for POC if we supply chain evidence and timestamped manifests.

2026-03-12 - Support (Ava Chen): Uploaded POC Avro file + RSA-PSS signed manifest to private S3 share and provided verification script. Requested NordBank SFTP creds to test direct delivery and confirmation that retention_map format meets their compliance team's needs.
investigation_notes:
- Confirmed signing-service uses AWS KMS RSA keys (RSA-PSS) and cannot produce ed25519 without feature work.
- HSM/KMS vendors used by dedicated/private customers support ed25519 via customer-managed keys (on-prem or BYOK) — we can support ed25519 in Private deployments sooner.
- Workaround: issue detached RSA-PSS manifest and include X.509 chain + RFC3161 timestamp token to satisfy audit.
- Need to define tenant_retention_map schema (proposed fields: tenant_id, field_name, retention_days, pii_class, legal_hold boolean, deletion_action). Shared Confluence draft linked above.
resolution: Triage complete. Interim workaround provided: RSA-PSS signed manifests with RFC3161 timestamp tokens and full X.509 key provenance bundle uploaded to customer S3 share for POC. Engineering scope item created to add ed25519 signing support to signing-service (tracked separately). Next steps: 1) NordBank to provide SFTP host/key for end-to-end test; 2) Support to confirm retention_map JSON schema with customer's compliance lead; 3) If NordBank requires ed25519 for production, escalate to PM/Infra for prioritized KMS/HSM work.
